svg.title: Illustration of a neuron's activation over forty tokens under the clean run, the clamp, the zero, the mean and the shuffled null. The clamp removes variation and keeps the level. The zero removes the level too.
svg.text: What each intervention does to a neuron
An illustration with made-up values, not data. Each bar is one token. Grey shows the clean activation.
Keeps the side's level, and removes its variation.
Every token holds the neuron's mean.
The clamp's changes, moved to other tokens.
